title: Remove the legacy EUI/ULA identity model from the canonical IPv6 API
description: P3 protocol correctness: python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py and its tests still present a node Identity derived from arbitrary EUI-64 plus mutable ULA/GUA prefix assignment, while the resolved architecture says one Ed25519 key derives the IID/link-local/native 0200::/8 address and ULA is not used. The duplicate Identity name and exported AddressManager/make_ula APIs let callers construct identities and scopes that cannot satisfy current trust/SCHC/routing bindings. Replace or clearly quarantine these generic helpers, expose the key-derived native scope in the canonical API, and update tests/docs so no supported Node identity path advertises ULA.
